answer_2.quote: We leverage the Negative Flip Rate (NFR) (our main goal) as the main metric to assess the model's ability to mitigate the negative flips, which is defined as the losing case of the aligned model compared to the SFT model, along with the win rate, i.e., the positive flip rate (extra bonus).
